env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Cross-package loGo/s pointers are non-nil (SPEC Sec 2.2, T-202).
# beta.New returns *beta.MyError from .lgo source, so alpha may return
# it as error with no nil check. The bad module keeps failing after
# the fix: a real Go pointer is still a platform pointer.
# Model: logos_facts_nil.txt and logos_interop_platform.txt (the
# named model file does not exist at this revision).
# Note: an imported option result bound to a local in a library
# package does not reach checking on this revision: the export
# writer has no Option case (noder/writer.go typIdx) and fails with
# "unexpected type: ... (*types2.Option)". Bisection: beta alone
# builds, alpha without option use builds, the same shape with a
# same-package option builds, and only the imported-option binding
# fails. That exporter hole is independent of this fix (the writer
# path is untouched) and is left as a follow-up; the option
# consequence is therefore not covered by this script.
cd ok
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/bin/cross$GOEXE ./cmd
exec $WORK/bin/cross$GOEXE
stdout '^cross ok: fresh boom$'
cd ..

cd bad
! logos build ./...
stderr 'platform pointer f \(\*os\.File\)'
cd ..

-- ok/go.mod --
module example.com/cross

go 1.27

-- ok/beta/beta.lgo --
package beta

type MyError struct {
	Msg string
}

func (e MyError) Error() string {
	return e.Msg
}

func New(msg string) *MyError {
	return &MyError{Msg: msg}
}

func ReturnLocal() error {
	e := New("local")
	return e
}

-- ok/alpha/alpha.lgo --
package alpha

import "example.com/cross/beta"

var ErrX = beta.New("boom")

func ReturnVar() error {
	return ErrX
}

func ReturnCall() error {
	e := beta.New("fresh")
	return e
}

-- ok/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/cross/alpha"
	"example.com/cross/beta"
)

func main() {
	if err := alpha.ReturnVar(); err == nil || err.Error() != "boom" {
		panic("ReturnVar")
	}
	if err := alpha.ReturnCall(); err == nil || err.Error() != "fresh" {
		panic("ReturnCall")
	}
	if err := beta.ReturnLocal(); err == nil || err.Error() != "local" {
		panic("ReturnLocal")
	}
	fmt.Println("cross ok: fresh boom")
}

-- bad/go.mod --
module example.com/crossbad

go 1.27

-- bad/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"io"
	"os"
)

func platformStillGo() io.Closer {
	f := os.Stdout
	return f
}

func main() {
	_ = platformStillGo()
}
